The first quarter of 2026 reflects challenging year‑over‑year comparisons, as distributors built inventories in the first quarter of 2025 to support the Sun Cruiser and Truly Unruly innovations, as well as modestly lower overall distributor inventory levels in 2026 resulting from improved supply chain responsiveness.
The Company believes distributor inventory as of March 28, 2026 was at an appropriate level for each of its brands and averaged approximately four and a half weeks on hand compared to five weeks at the end of the first quarter of 2025.
